name: Semantic-Aware Gaussian Splatting (SA-GS)
definition: A Gaussian Splatting variant that uses semantic masks and geometric complexity constraints to refine Gaussian shapes and reduce the number of splats, improving geometric reconstruction and reducing GPU memory consumption.
summary: Semantic-Aware Gaussian Splatting is a 3D Gaussian Splatting variant that uses semantic masks and geometric complexity to refine shapes, reduce splat count, and improve reconstruction quality.
